exposure: Maternal Hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) positivity
Adverse pregnancy outcomes (premature labor, gestational diabetes mellitus, pre-eclampsia, fetal growth retardation, fetal distress)
Infant Apgar scores at 1 and 5 minutes
finding: High levels of HBV in maternal blood, particularly positive HBeAg and HBV DNA, were significantly associated with HBV intrauterine infection, while other maternal and neonatal factors did not show a significant correlation.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was not significantly correlated with HBV intrauterine infection.
